caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition bordered by a green frame and a thinner red inner border. At the top, the large text “SARAH CAMPION” is written in ornate black lettering, with “CAMPION” overlapping a background of green leafy branches and red flowers. Below this, there is a line of multicolored diamond or chevron pattern acting as a divider. The center text reads: “Daughter of Joseph Campion & Mary his wife Was Born November ye 16th Anno Domini 1777” in a smaller, decorated script. Another band of the diamond/chevron pattern appears beneath this text. The bottom section of the drawing contains illustrated figures. To the left, there are two standing figures, one in blue with a red outer garment and one in brown and reddish clothing. In the center is a round, red-yellow striped pot holding a large leafy branch with red flowers. To the right of the pot, there are three standing figures dressed mostly in red with white aprons, facing the center. The background of the central panel is a cream or light beige. The overall palette features muted tones of green, red, yellow, brown, blue, and beige, and the drawing uses both ink and watercolor for the illustration and text.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
